question: Close the prefill parity gap by taking the Q4 and BF16 prefill quantized matmul off the GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix interface that caps it: establish on driver-level evidence whether register dequant feeding the matrix instruction is expressible on Honeykrisp, and otherwise land an explicitly hand-scheduled scalar FMA kernel with four or more independent accumulator chains that beats the shipped 1.0 TFLOP/s without the matrix instruction.
base: origin/main a0775c37; branch wave/PrefillNativeOrder (landed commit 877c2f1c + follow-ups on the branch).

finding_1_register_dequant_not_expressib.claim: A SPIR-V cooperative-matrix B operand built from per-invocation (register) values is NOT expressible on the installed driver: some memory round trip is mandatory, and the zero-traffic cooperative-matrix ceiling (1440 GFLOP/s at gate_up, receipts/2026-09-11-qmm-coop-datapath arm 4; 1459 in-geometry 8-chain, receipts/2026-09-11-coopmat-ilp-chains) is below the native implied ~1.66 TFLOP/s, so the matrix unit cannot reach parity at the dominant prefill shape regardless of operand transport.

driver_evidence.method: benchq/qmm-fma/coopmat_probe.c creates a real VkPipeline from hand-assembled SPIR-V on the installed fork driver; control and attempt modules in benchq/qmm-fma/*.spvasm
driver_evidence.control: OpCooperativeMatrixLoadKHR from a StorageBuffer pointer: pipeline creation VK_SUCCESS (probe-control.log)
driver_evidence.attempt: OpCooperativeMatrixLoadKHR from a Private-storage pointer (per-invocation values): driver SPIR-V parser REJECTS the module - 'SPIR-V id 15 is the wrong kind of value: expected pointer OR null constant' - spirv_to_nir failed, pipeline creation VK_ERROR_UNKNOWN (probe-private.log)
driver_evidence.grammar_fact: SPIR-V has no opcode that constructs a cooperative matrix from per-invocation scalar values; the only producers are OpCooperativeMatrixLoadNV/KHR, and Mesa's spirv_to_nir admits only Workgroup/StorageBuffer-class pointers for them
driver_evidence.raw_logs: window1.log and window1c.log 'driver-level coopmat construction probe' sections, probe-control.log, probe-private.log

kernels.q4: shaders/qmm_fma.comp: 128-lane workgroups, 4 warps, each lane owns 16 rows x 2 columns with 32 independent f32 accumulator chains; x read as uvec4 (8 f16 per vector, exact unpackHalf2x16), each packed w word dequantized in registers (scale*float(nibble)+bias, f32), no shared memory, no barriers, no coopMatLoad; the accumulator contraction class follows the shipped tile boundary - fused below m=1024, precise (NoContraction) at and above - so both drivers' pinned digests hold; drains f16 word pairs with packHalf2x16 (RNE)
kernels.bf16: shaders/matmul_fma_bf16.comp: same skeleton for the linear-layer orientation (row-major lhs, column-major rhs, alpha==1, m>=32, k%8==0); f32 accumulators over exactly-widened bf16, drain through the same bf16_store RNE word packing as MatmulBF16Coopmat
kernels.dispatch: primitives.cpp QuantizedMatmul and dispatch_matmul pick the FMA kernels ahead of the cooperative-matrix picks on the same shape gates plus n%2==0/k%8==0 and 16-byte operand alignment (rarer x views materialize); MLX_OMARCHY_NO_QMM_FMA / MLX_OMARCHY_NO_MATMUL_FMA fall back to the cooperative-matrix routes for A/B

digest_screens.method: window1/window1c scripts: full six-leg bench_matrix runs against the committed pins per driver, bench wheel from the branch
digest_screens.fused_variant: fork 6/6 HELD; stock 5/6 - Q4 1K leg moved to 31267e7ed4c6d0dc (screen-fork/screen-stock logs)
digest_screens.precise_variant: fork 6/6 HELD; stock 5/6 - Q4 262-token leg moved to f873dc2bdd34c0fe while 1K returned to 7da83f06ec9f001d (precise-fork/precise-stock logs)
digest_screens.interpretation: the two stock sub-routes (fused tile below m=1024, precise tile at and above) were pinned under two different contraction classes; the landed route reproduces the class boundary per m, and every leg x driver x class cell was screened before landing
digest_screens.screen_caught_a_bug: the first screen (window1) caught an x uvec4 indexing bug in the q4 kernel (kw/4 read the wrong k window for 7 of 8 steps per group) via Q4 digest movement on both drivers, before any timing was trusted; the bf16 kernel held all three BF16 leg digests on both drivers in that same screen

finding_2_scalar_fma_route_landed.qualification: window2: six-leg digest matrix, discarded warmup + 3 repetitions per driver (fork honeykrisp hk6f6afc8-1, stock Mesa via private ICD), candidate wheel 877c2f1c paired against the same tree without the change (base wheel a0775c37), interleaved in one flock window; perf fractions against receipts/native-baseline-2026-09-06 denominators; wheel sha256 printed in drivers-window2.txt and per-leg provenance lines

hardware: jwm1-linux, Apple M1 (G13G B1), kernel 7.1.6-1-1-ARCH aarch64; every GPU access under one top-level flock /tmp/m1-gpu.lock; windows announced on hub; quiet-CPU gate (1-min loadavg < 1.0 x3) before every measured run; wall-anchored timing only
